payload.posture: Read Acts 19:1–20 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states disciples, the Spirit, teaching, and signs in Ephesus. While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples. So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
